title: Release notes fail when the selected tag is missing
author: maya
body: Choosing v0.4.3 before creating the tag leaves the notes run without a source revision. Keep the draft and let me choose an existing tag.

title: Document how to shut down a Node server gracefully
author: cora
body: The adapter returns a Node server, but the guide does not show how to stop accepting requests and wait for active responses. Add a short SIGTERM example.

title: Expose an optional method filter in inspect()
author: dev-ahn
body: I use inspect() to generate a route table. Filtering by method in the router would avoid copying the matching rules into the script.

title: Measure route lookup with 500 static paths
author: maya
body: Before considering a new route data structure, collect median and p95 lookup times for 10, 100, and 500 routes. Keep the benchmark input and runtime version beside the results.

title: Add a request id example without logging headers
author: cora
body: Show middleware that accepts or creates a request id and places it on the response. Do not print authorization headers, cookies, bodies, or query values.

title: Should duplicate query keys become arrays?
author: dev-ahn
body: `?tag=a&tag=b` currently returns `{ tag: "b" }`. Is keeping the last value intentional? I need repeated filters and want to understand the API before wrapping it.

comments.author: maya
comments.body: Keeping the last value is the current contract. If we add arrays, use an opt-in helper so existing request.query code keeps its type.

title: Explain the 405 Allow header in the routing guide
author: maya
body: Add a concrete GET-only route followed by a POST request and show the resulting 405 status and Allow header.

title: Abort a streaming response when a Node client disconnects
author: cora
body: A client that closes its connection while a response is streaming can leave the producer running. Connect the Node response close event to stream cancellation and test with a real socket.

comments.author: cora
comments.body: Use a real socket and a stream with a cancellation spy. The existing adapter test only covers successful completion.

title: Keep Set-Cookie headers separate in the Node adapter
author: dev-ahn
body: Two cookies set on a Web Response appear as a single header after crossing the Node adapter. I will attach a reproduction with two cookies and no commas in their values.

title: Reject wildcard CORS origins when credentials are enabled
author: maya
body:
Browsers reject `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` with credentials. The helper accepts this combination and the request fails only in the browser.

```ts
app.use(cors({ credentials: true }))
```

Reject the configuration before serving, or require an explicit origin. Which behavior should be the default?

comments.author: cora
comments.body: Please reject the configuration when the middleware is constructed. Silently dropping credentials would hide the mistake.

comments.author: smithers-agent
comments.body: The constructor guard is ready. Maya’s choice is pending before I finish the compatibility note.

title: Malformed percent escapes in route params return 500
author: dev-ahn
body:
A malformed URL parameter reaches decodeURIComponent and becomes an internal error. This is client input and should return 400.

```ts
const app = new Router()
app.get("/users/:id", req => Response.json(req.params))
const response = await app.handle("GET", "/users/%ZZ")
console.log(response.status) // 500; expected 400
```

A valid `%20` must continue to decode to a space. Please keep the original error private and use a safe response message.

comments.author: maya
comments.body: Accepted. Add a regression for malformed escapes and keep valid encoded params working.

comments.author: smithers-agent
comments.body: Reproduced with `/users/%ZZ`. The fix returns 400 with a safe message, and the valid `%20` regression still passes. Ready for Maya’s review in #32.

comments.author: maya
comments.body: Reviewed the diff, ran the regression, and merged #32.

title: Describe trailing slash behavior with a route example
author: maya
body: The strictSlash option is in the type but the readme does not show its effect. Show `/items` and `/items/` with both settings.

title: Preflight should respect an explicit allowed header list
author: cora
body: When a browser asks for x-request-id and content-type, document which headers the helper will accept. Add a test where the requested header is absent from the configured list.

title: Support an explicit HEAD route helper
author: dev-ahn
body: GET handles HEAD today. I would like a head() helper to return cheaper metadata for a large streamed resource. Keep the GET fallback when no explicit handler is registered.

title: Mount a router under a path prefix
author: dev-ahn
body: Can a router be mounted under `/api/v1` without copying each route? A small group helper may be enough; nested middleware and path params need a clear contract first.

title: Publish the minimum supported Node version
author: cora
body: The Node adapter uses Web Request and stream conversion. State the minimum Node version in package metadata and in the adapter page.

title: Add an integration test for slow request bodies
author: maya
body: Exercise a request body delivered in several chunks through node:http. The response must wait for valid JSON and reject the body when the byte limit is crossed.

title: Should HttpError include an application error code?
author: dev-ahn
body: A stable error code would help clients distinguish validation errors without parsing messages. Could this be a field in the JSON response rather than an additional class hierarchy?

title: Add a websocket implementation to the router
author: maya
body: A websocket server needs upgrade, connection lifetime, and backpressure APIs beyond the current request-response boundary. Keep the runtime-specific upgrade handler in the host application.

title: Explain how middleware can return early
author: maya
body: Add an authentication example that returns 401 before next(). The example should demonstrate the control flow without including a real token or an authentication service.

title: JSON body reads can ignore an absent content-length
author: cora
body: A chunked request can exceed the configured size limit. Count the bytes read from the stream instead of trusting only the content-length header.

title: Logger includes query values in its path field
author: cora
body: Request URLs can contain private search text. Log only the pathname, status, and elapsed time, without query strings or headers.

title: Empty query values (?a=) parse to undefined instead of an empty string
author: maya
body:
`parseQuery("?a=")` returns `{}` — the `a` key is dropped. A form that submits an empty field cannot be told apart from one that never sent it.

Expected: `{ a: "" }`.

```ts
parseQuery("?a=&b=2")
// expected { a: "", b: "2" }
```

A bare key such as `?a` should still be ignored. Preserve plus-to-space decoding and values containing equals signs.

comments.author: smithers-agent
comments.body: The regression fails on main. I have a patch on `smithers/empty-query-values`; the verification stage is still running.

title: Error responses expose the original exception message
author: maya
body: An unexpected exception must not expose implementation details to a client. Return a generic 500 response while keeping HttpError messages safe and explicit.

title: Router matched /users before /users/:id
author: maya
body:
Registration order decided ties; the static route lost to the param route registered first.

```ts
app.get("/users/:id", () => new Response("param"))
app.get("/users/me", () => new Response("static"))
```

GET /users/me should return static regardless of registration order.

title: Node adapter buffers an entire response
author: cora
body: A streamed response was collected before sending its first byte. Pipe the Web ReadableStream to the outgoing response and wait for completion.

title: Plus signs are not decoded as spaces in query values
author: maya
body: `parseQuery("q=hello+world")` returned a literal plus sign. Form-style query encoding uses plus for a space; `%2B` must still mean a literal plus.

title: Tests need to run against the public package entry
author: dev-ahn
body: Add a small test that imports Router and the query helpers from src/index.ts so renaming an internal module cannot silently break the public entry.
